effort: Accelerate the arms in pushing and pulling while the trunk supplies a stable base; retain a straight-ahead release.

explosive.name: Kneeling Medicine Ball Chest Pass — tall kneeling, no hip swing
explosive.job: Primary straight-ahead release with leg drive removed.
explosive.cue: Knees on a comfortable surface, hips extended; hold ball at chest for 1 s, release rapidly with both arms and remain tall.
explosive.replacement: a seated chest pass if kneeling is uncomfortable, or a self-anchored band speed chest press if no release area exists; log the changed task and any lost throws
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Related to Class 1 chest passes, explicitly not a new projection family. Removing leg contribution isolates the arm/trunk job; selected over another standing load/stance change. Six attempts replace the prior nine main throws.
explosive.key: Kneeling Medicine Ball Chest Pass — tall kneeling, no hip swing

explosive.name: Landmine Press — one-arm strict speed press
explosive.job: Accelerate a unilateral push against a guided load while the body resists turning.
explosive.cue: Standing feet fixed, bar end at shoulder; press forward/up rapidly without a knee dip, then lower 2 s; maintain grip throughout.
explosive.replacement: a light self-anchored single-arm band press with the other hand securing the tail at the torso if the bar is too heavy; no band release
explosive.identity: landmine-press; generated canonical family; strict fast delivery proposed
explosive.uniqueness_reason: First guided-load unilateral acceleration with deliberate load deceleration; differs from Class 1 free ball release and closed-chain hand flight.
explosive.key: Landmine Press — one-arm strict speed press

explosive.name: Seated Hand-over-Hand Battle-Rope Pull — free rope on floor
explosive.job: Link a secure grip to rapid horizontal traction, transferring the draw between arms.
explosive.cue: Lay a manageable free rope length straight within the inspected lane; sit, brace feet, alternate 4 short pulls per arm without leaning backward. Regrip after each pull; rope never wraps around the body. No fixed anchor or attached weight.
explosive.replacement: an alternating seated band row with permitted foot anchoring if rope mass/friction or lane clearance prevents controlled quick pulls; record the lost rope-transfer task
explosive.identity: Proposed exact execution; no verified canonical identifier
explosive.uniqueness_reason: A grip-transfer traction task with rope translation; neither a renamed landmine row nor a conditioning rope-wave interval. No claimed canonical ID.
explosive.key: Seated Hand-over-Hand Battle-Rope Pull — free rope on floor

explosive.name: Foot-Supported Pull-Up — fast ascent, controlled return
explosive.job: Express a rapid bodyweight pull from above while leg support keeps arm speed controllable.
explosive.cue: Use an inspected pull-up bar and immovable box so feet remain supported throughout; overhand shoulder-width grip, no kip. Pull up quickly, lower 2 s, reset without jumping or dropping.
explosive.replacement: a rapid Band Lat Pulldown on an inspected rated overhead attachment if the bar/support geometry is unsuitable
explosive.identity: Related to Assisted Pull-Up / assisted-pull-up in band library; exact foot-supported fast execution proposed, not quarantined source-198 negatives
explosive.uniqueness_reason: First vertical bodyweight draw; force direction, moving mass and elbow/shoulder coordination differ from Class 1 external-load rows.
explosive.key: Foot-Supported Pull-Up — fast ascent, controlled return

explosive.name: Band Chest Press — simultaneous fast extension, no release
explosive.job: Continue pressing force into rising elastic tension through the finish.
explosive.cue: Band crosses upper back below neck, ends secured in hands using a permitted setup; feet fixed, fast forward press, controlled 2 s return without snapping elbows.
explosive.replacement: a non-flight fast incline push-up if no suitable self-anchored band is available
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Previously listed only as a Class 1 equipment fallback, not a performed drill. First main prescription of retained-load elastic pressing; no claim that a band alone creates a wholly new push family.
explosive.key: Band Chest Press — simultaneous fast extension, no release

explosive.name: Band Straight-Arm Pulldown — rapid shoulder extension
explosive.job: Initiate the pull through shoulder extension without elbow flexion masking the action.
explosive.cue: Inspected overhead attachment; elbows softly fixed, pull hands from comfortable overhead reach to thighs quickly, return 2 s. Ribs stay quiet; no crunch or hip drive.
explosive.replacement: a light dumbbell pullover with controlled rapid return toward vertical and a shortened comfortable range if no rated anchor exists; log that it is not an equivalent speed test

explosive.key: Band Straight-Arm Pulldown — rapid shoulder extension

resilience.name: Supine Dumbbell Serratus Reach — elbows straight
resilience.job: Lightly load scapular reach at the press finish while the floor supports trunk position.
resilience.cue: Very light paired dumbbells above chest; keep elbows straight, reach shoulder blades slightly off floor 2 s, hold 1 s, return 2 s without rolling the trunk.
resilience.replacement: an unloaded supine reach through the same comfortable range
resilience.identity: Proposed exact execution; no verified canonical identifier
resilience.key: Supine Dumbbell Serratus Reach — elbows straight

resilience.name: Bilateral Band External Rotation — elbows at sides
resilience.job: Light shoulder-rotator strengthening to control upper-arm position during the day's press and pull.
resilience.cue: Unanchored band between hands, elbows at ribs; rotate outward 2 s, hold 1 s, return 2 s without shrugging.
resilience.replacement: a lower-tension band and shorter comfortable range
resilience.key: Bilateral Band External Rotation — elbows at sides

primary.name: Floor Press — two dumbbells, neutral grip
primary.job: Main horizontal pressing force with a reproducible floor-limited range.
primary.cue: Lower 2 s, touch upper arms gently, pause 1 s, then press decisively; feet stay down. Coach supervises pickup/set-down.
primary.replacement: a lighter floor press through controlled comfortable range

primary.name: One-Arm Row — dumbbell, hand and knee on bench
primary.job: Load the arm-driven backward draw while support prevents torso rotation.
primary.cue: Draw elbow toward hip, hold 1 s, lower 2 s; stop before the shoulder rolls forward or the trunk turns.
primary.replacement: a thigh-supported dumbbell row with the same arm path if a bench does not fit

primary.name: Push-Up — controlled full repetition
primary.job: Load the press with free shoulder-blade movement and a steady trunk.
primary.cue: Lower 2 s, push decisively, finish tall through shoulders for 1 s; no hand flight. Adjust leverage or band resistance to reach 2–3 RIR.
primary.replacement: a hands-elevated push-up on an inspected immovable support

primary.name: Band Lat Pulldown — kneeling, two arms
primary.job: Load the downward arm draw needed for assisted pull-up force without another horizontal row set.
primary.cue: Use a manufacturer-permitted band on an inspected overhead anchor; kneel tall, draw elbows to ribs, hold 1 s, return 2 s; no lumbar lean.
primary.replacement: a foot-supported pull-up with comfortable grip and enough assistance to preserve 2–3 RIR; otherwise a supported row with the vertical-pull gap recorded
primary.identity: band-lat-pulldown; resistance-band-body-resistance-all-cards.json; exact setup must be inspected

primary.name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher — floor-supported
primary.job: Load elbow extension for the finish of a forceful press.
primary.cue: Neutral grips, upper arms near vertical; lower 2 s beside the ears, extend under control without shoulder swing.
primary.replacement: a lighter floor-supported elbow extension through comfortable range

primary.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl — simultaneous arms
primary.job: Load elbow flexors for finishing the backward draw without another shoulder-extension set.
primary.cue: Upper arms stay at ribs; lift 1 s, hold 1 s, lower 2 s, without hip swing or wrist collapse.
primary.replacement: a lighter neutral-grip curl without body movement

progression: Class 1 main Floor Press 2 × 6 and One-Arm Row 2 × 6 per arm → same doses here because no completion or recovery is reported. P3/P5/P6 also retain their direct strength roles and doses; P4 changes from wide-elbow row to 1 × 8 Band Lat Pulldown to support today's overhead draw. This is a redistribution of work, not an earned load increase. Next exposure: hold these strength loads unless actual controlled completion at 2–3 RIR and satisfactory recovery supports one small relevant change.
audit_findings: Removed a second chest-pass variant and all hand-flight landings from this class. Main throws fall from nine to six while five short supporting tasks address different push/pull mechanics. Vertical pulling is explicitly assigned to the requested pulling subcategory rather than claimed to improve passing directly. No weighted chin-ups, ballistic weight releases or fatigue circuits. Two related task families are disclosed; the other four are new force/coordination tasks. Light resilience work remains far from fatigue.
next_job: Class 3 should emphasize pulling force from the shoulder through the elbow, review today's new pulling exposure and preserve a modest direct projection task without assuming it was tolerated.
